title: Beyond the Sovereign
summary: The ultimate grand finale of the 100-chapter master saga. Ha-Jun Kang visits the Saint Mirren rooftop one last time, offering a timeless message of hope, family, and eternal peace.

panels.shot: the quiet rainy rooftop of saint mirren university at twilight
panels.action: The iconic rooftop terrace of Saint Mirren University in a soft, gentle twilight drizzle—the exact spot where Episode 1 began.

dialogue.text: WHERE IT ALL BEGAN.

panels.prose_en: The iconic rooftop terrace of Saint Mirren University in a soft, gentle twilight drizzle—the exact spot where Episode 1 began.
panels.prose_hi: Halki, dhundhli dhundhlake mein sent miren university ki pratishthit chhat - theek wahi sthan jahan episode 1 shuru hua tha.

panels.shot: 25-year-old ha-jun kang leaning against the familiar stone balustrade
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands in his black coat, hands resting on the cool stone balustrade, looking out over the neon skyline of Seoul.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yahin par... Ek toofani raat ko... Meri aankhon mein sirf aansu the.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands in his black coat, hands resting on the cool stone balustrade, looking out over the neon skyline of Seoul.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne kale coat mein khada hai, haath thande patthar ke chhajje par tikae hue hai, aur seoul ke nean kshitij ko dekh raha hai.

panels.shot: flashback ghost overlay: 17-year-old bruised ha-jun crying in the rain
panels.action: A faint transparent ghost image of 17-year-old Ha-Jun from Episode 1 sits curled on the wet floor, bruised and weeping.
panels.prose_en: A faint transparent ghost image of 17-year-old Ha-Jun from Episode 1 sits curled on the wet floor, bruised and weeping.
panels.prose_hi: Episod 1 se 17-varshiy Ha-Jun ki ek dhundhli pardarshi bhoot chhavi gile farsh par chot khae hue aur roti hui baithi hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking down at the ghost of his past self with infinite compassion
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down at the crying boy, whispering gently: 'You made it through the storm, little one. You're safe now.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumhara toofan khatam ho chuka hai. Tumne sabko bacha liya.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks down at the crying boy, whispering gently: 'You made it through the storm, little one. You're safe now.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun rote hue ladke ki or dekhta hai aur dheere se fusfusata hai: 'tu toofan se bach gaya, chhote bacche. ab aap surakshit han.'

panels.shot: the ghost of the crying boy dissolving into warm golden stardust
panels.action: The memory boy looks up, smiles through his tears, and dissolves into peaceful golden fireflies that rise into the rain.
panels.prose_en: The memory boy looks up, smiles through his tears, and dissolves into peaceful golden fireflies that rise into the rain.
panels.prose_hi: Smriti balak upar dekhta hai, apne asuon ke madhyam se muskurata hai, aur baarish mein uthne wale shantipurna sunhare juganuon mein vilin ho jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro landing softly on the balustrade folding glossy obsidian wings
panels.action: Kuro settles beside Ha-Jun's hands, his feathers beading with clean rain droplets, ruby eyes glowing softly.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The rooftop feels different when you aren't crying, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Kuro settles beside Ha-Jun's hands, his feathers beading with clean rain droplets, ruby eyes glowing softly.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro Ha-Jun ke hathon ke paas baith jata hai, uske pankhon par saaf baarish ki bunden chamak rahi han, ruby aankhen dheere se chamak rahi han.

panels.shot: ha-jun laughing softly stroking kuro head with his finger
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles, stroking Kuro's head: 'It feels different because you're here with me, Kuro.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum mere saath the. Har ek kadam pe.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles, stroking Kuro's head: 'It feels different because you're here with me, Kuro.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun muskurata hai, Kuro ke sir par haath ferta hai: 'yah alag lagta hai kyonki tum yahan mere saath ho, Kuro.'

panels.shot: a familiar pair of boots clicking on the wet concrete terrace
panels.action: Quiet, steady boot-steps approach; a large black umbrella opens with a soft whoosh overhead.
panels.prose_en: Quiet, steady boot-steps approach; a large black umbrella opens with a soft whoosh overhead.
panels.prose_hi: Shant, sthir boot-step drishtikon; ek bada kala chhata khulta hai jiske sir par ek naram hush hai.

panels.shot: kang tae-jun holding the umbrella over ha-jun head smiling warmly
panels.action: Kang Tae-Jun stands beside him, holding the umbrella over both of them, his warm eyes full of brotherly devotion.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: I told you seven years ago... As long as I'm here, no storm will ever touch you.

panels.prose_en: Kang Tae-Jun stands beside him, holding the umbrella over both of them, his warm eyes full of brotherly devotion.
panels.prose_hi: Cong Tae-Jun uske bagal mein khada hai, donon ke upar chhata pakde hue, uski garm aankhen bhaichare ki bhakti se bhari han.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at tae-jun under the umbrella with pure love
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles back, leaning his shoulder against Tae-Jun's arm: 'I know, Hyung. You kept your promise.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aapne apna har ek vaada poora kiya.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles back, leaning his shoulder against Tae-Jun's arm: 'I know, Hyung. You kept your promise.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun muskurata hai, Tae-Jun ki baanh par apna kandha jhukata hai: 'mujhe pata hai, hung. aapne apna vaada nibhaya.'

panels.shot: the rooftop door bursting open: min-jae jogging out with two warm coats
panels.action: Min-Jae runs onto the terrace, waving two warm wool scarves: 'You two are going to catch a cold standing in the drizzle!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Wrap these around your necks! Dinner is waiting downstairs!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae runs onto the terrace, waving two warm wool scarves: 'You two are going to catch a cold standing in the drizzle!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je do garm uni scarf lahrate hue chhat par daudati hai: 'tum donon ko bundabandi mein khade hokar thand lagne wali hai!'

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun laughing as min-jae wraps scarves around their necks
panels.action: The brothers laugh heartily as Min-Jae fussily wraps red wool scarves around their necks like an overprotective mother.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae, I'm the Demon Sovereign. I don't catch colds.

panels.prose_en: The brothers laugh heartily as Min-Jae fussily wraps red wool scarves around their necks like an overprotective mother.
panels.prose_hi: Jab min-je ek atyadhik surakshatmak maa ki tarah apni gardan ke charon or lal uni scarf lapetati hai to bhai dil kholkar hanste han.

panels.shot: min-jae scoffing proudly adjusting his glasses: 'sovereigns still get the flu!'
panels.action: Min-Jae huffs: 'I don't care if you're the Sovereign of Galaxies! Pneumonia doesn't check credentials!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Flu virus ko tumhare domain se koi farq nahi padta!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae huffs: 'I don't care if you're the Sovereign of Galaxies! Pneumonia doesn't check credentials!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je hafs: 'mujhe koi fark nahin padta ki aap akashgangaon ke samprabhu han! nimoniya saakh ki janch nahin karta!

panels.shot: general baek walking onto the terrace holding a tray of warm roasted chestnuts
panels.action: General Baek arrives, laughing: 'Listen to your administrator, Ha-Jun! Here, have some warm roasted chestnuts.'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Fresh roasted from the Hongdae cart!

panels.prose_en: General Baek arrives, laughing: 'Listen to your administrator, Ha-Jun! Here, have some warm roasted chestnuts.'.
panels.prose_hi: Janaral bak hanste hue pahunche: 'apne prashasak Ha-Jun ki baat suno! yahan, kuch garm bhune hue akhrot lijiye.'

panels.shot: kuro immediately snatching a hot chestnut in his talons juggling it
panels.action: Kuro snatches a steaming chestnut, juggling it comically between his talons: 'Hot! Hot! Exquisite roasted mortal nut!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Too hot! But delicious!

panels.prose_en: Kuro snatches a steaming chestnut, juggling it comically between his talons: 'Hot! Hot! Exquisite roasted mortal nut!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ek ubalta hua chestnut chheen leta hai, use apne panjon ke beech hasyapurn tarike se khinchta hai: 'hot! garm! uttam bhuna hua nashwar akharot!'.

panels.shot: all four companions bursting into helpless, joyful laughter in the rain
panels.action: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Baek laugh together under the umbrella as rain softly drumrolls on the fabric.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Baek laugh together under the umbrella as rain softly drumrolls on the fabric.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, min-je, aur bak chhatri ke neeche ek saath hanste hain kyonki baarish kapde par dhire-dhire gir rahi hai.

panels.shot: the rain gradually stopping: clouds parting over the seoul skyline
panels.action: The drizzle stops; the evening storm clouds part, revealing a breathtaking canopy of millions of diamond stars.
panels.prose_en: The drizzle stops; the evening storm clouds part, revealing a breathtaking canopy of millions of diamond stars.
panels.prose_hi: Boondabandi ruk jaati hai; sham ko toofani badal chhantate han, jisse lakhon heere sitaron ki ek lubhavani chhatri dikhai deti hai.

panels.shot: a majestic silver full moon rising behind namsan tower
panels.action: A huge, luminous silver full moon rises into the indigo night sky, casting a peaceful milky sheen over Seoul.
panels.prose_en: A huge, luminous silver full moon rises into the indigo night sky, casting a peaceful milky sheen over Seoul.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vishal, chamakdar chandi ka purnima ka chandrama neel raat ke aakash mein ugta hai, jo seoul par ek shantipurna dudhiya chamak bikherta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping out from under the umbrella looking up at the moon
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward, letting the cool night breeze ruffle his black hair as he gazes up at the moon.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps forward, letting the cool night breeze ruffle his black hair as he gazes up at the moon.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aage badhta hai, raat ki thandi hawa uske kale baalon ko jhakjhor deti hai aur wah chandrama ki or dekhta hai.

panels.shot: inside ha-jun chest: the ten relics resting in quiet, eternal slumber
panels.action: Deep in his heart, the ten relics pulse like a gentle, rhythmic lullaby, forever pacified and at rest.

dialogue.text: The weapons had become a garden.

panels.prose_en: Deep in his heart, the ten relics pulse like a gentle, rhythmic lullaby, forever pacified and at rest.
panels.prose_hi: Uske dil ki gahrai men, das avashesh ek saumya, laybaddh lori ki tarah, hamesha ke liye shant aur vishram mein spandit hote han.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping beside ha-jun resting his hand on his shoulder
panels.action: Tae-Jun joins his side, their shoulders touching: 'What are you thinking, Ha-Jun?'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Kya soch rahe ho?

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun joins his side, their shoulders touching: 'What are you thinking, Ha-Jun?'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun uske paksh mein shamil ho jata hai, unke kandhe chhute han: 'aap kya soch rahe han, Ha-Jun?'.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at tae-jun with clear, calm, beautiful eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles: 'I was thinking that if I had to live these 100 chapters all over again... I wouldn't change a single day.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main apna ek bhi din nahi badalna chahta. Because it brought me here, with you.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles: 'I was thinking that if I had to live these 100 chapters all over again... I wouldn't change a single day.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun muskurata hai: 'main soch raha tha ki agar mujhe in 100 adhyaayon ko dobara jeena pade... to main ek bhi din nahin badlunga.'

panels.shot: tae-jun eyes glistening with tears smiling back warmly
panels.action: Tae-Jun's eyes shine with proud tears: 'Neither would I, little brother. Neither would I.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Main bhi nahi, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's eyes shine with proud tears: 'Neither would I, little brother. Neither would I.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ki aankhen garv se chamak uthin: 'ne hi main, chhote bhai. main bhi nahin.'

panels.shot: min-jae and baek raising their warm chestnut bags in a quiet toast
panels.action: Min-Jae and Baek smile warmly: 'To the Kang brothers. The true guardians of our world.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: To our heroes.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae and Baek smile warmly: 'To the Kang brothers. The true guardians of our world.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je aur bake garmjoshi se muskurate han: 'cong bhaiyon ke liye. hamari duniya ke sacche sanrshak.'

panels.shot: kuro spreading his dark wings silhouette against the giant full moon
panels.action: Kuro takes flight, circling once against the silver face of the moon, his shadow an emblem of eternal freedom.

dialogue.text: An ancient crow found a weeping boy in the rain. And together, they saved the stars.

panels.prose_en: Kuro takes flight, circling once against the silver face of the moon, his shadow an emblem of eternal freedom.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro udaan bharta hai, chandrama ke chandi ke chehre ke samne ek baar chakkar lagata hai, uski chhaya shashwat swatantrata ka prateek hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun turning his head toward the camera looking directly at the reader
panels.action: Ha-Jun Kang turns toward the viewer, his handsome face bathed in silver moonlight and warm streetlamp gold.

dialogue.text: A direct look from the Sovereign to the soul who read his story.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun Kang turns toward the viewer, his handsome face bathed in silver moonlight and warm streetlamp gold.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun kang darshak ki or mudta hai, uska sundar chehra chandi ki chandni aur garm street lamp sone mein nahaya hua hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling with an unforgettable, warm, thankful smile
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles with deep, humble, unforgettable gratitude: 'Thank you for believing in me when I was weak.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Thank you for staying with me until the very end.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles with deep, humble, unforgettable gratitude: 'Thank you for believing in me when I was weak.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun gahri, vinamra, avismarniya kritagyata ke saath muskurata hai: 'jab main kamjor tha tab mujh par vishwas karne ke liye dhanyavad.'

panels.shot: the camera slowly pulling back into the night sky over seoul
panels.action: The view pulls upward and away, showing Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Baek laughing on the rooftop under the moon.
panels.prose_en: The view pulls upward and away, showing Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Baek laughing on the rooftop under the moon.
panels.prose_hi: Drishya upar aur door khinchta hai, jisme Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, min-je aur bak chandrama ke neeche chhat par hanste hue dikhai de rahe han.

panels.shot: the city of seoul glittering peacefully like a field of fallen stars
panels.action: The sprawling, tranquil city of Seoul glows with millions of warm, safe lights beneath a clear, peaceful universe.

dialogue.text: The bloodline is redeemed. The covenant is fulfilled. The Sovereign is at peace.

panels.prose_en: The sprawling, tranquil city of Seoul glows with millions of warm, safe lights beneath a clear, peaceful universe.
panels.prose_hi: Siyol ka vishal, shant shahar ek spasht, shantipurna brahmand ke neeche lakhon garm, surakshit roshni se jagmagata hai.

panels.shot: the final grand curtain panel: DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — COMPLETE
panels.action: A magnificent, cinematic final panel: the moon shining over the peaceful Earth, with golden calligraphy closing the saga: 'DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — COMPLETE (100 CHAPTERS / 3,000 PANELS)'.

dialogue.text: THE SAGA IS COMPLETE. THANK YOU FOR READING.

panels.prose_en: A magnificent, cinematic final panel: the moon shining over the peaceful Earth, with golden calligraphy closing the saga: 'DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — COMPLETE (100 CHAPTERS / 3,000 PANELS)'.
panels.prose_hi: Ek shandar, cinemai antim panal: shantipurna prithvi par chamakta chandrama, sunhare sulekh ke saath gatha ko band kar raha hai: 'danav samprabhu ki raktarekha - purna (100 adhyay / 3,000 panal)'.
